all_z_unstitched_Hamiltonian_Sachs_diagn.mathematical_explanation: Integrating the Sachs ODE smoothly from z = 0 to z_* ~ 1090 in u = ln(1+z) with NO z = 2.5 stitch shows that replacing E_hor -> E_ray in the expansion damping while retaining unmodified homogeneous FLRW matter focusing 1.5*Omega_m0*(1+z)^3 breaks the FLRW cancellation E_ray*E_ray' = Ricci_source, generating an O(alpha) secular drift in D_M(z_*) that restricts alpha_hat to -0.048 +- 0.024. Depleting the Ricci matter focusing along underdense rays by (1 - alpha_eff) partially restores positive alpha_hat, confirming that consistent 4D light-cone averaging of expansion and Ricci focusing is an open theoretical problem beyond the 1D H2-vol distance template.

theoretical_H2_vol_scale_and_exploratory.status_note: Exploratory low-redshift null check ONLY: at z <= 0.105 the theoretical H2-vol sightline signal (-0.006 to -0.013 mag) has ~0.3-0.4 sigma expected SNR relative to the +- 0.036 mag uncertainty of N = 280 unique Pantheon+ SNe, and low-z void boundary peculiar velocities (Bolejko et al. 2013, PRL 110, 021302) contribute comparable variance.
